about: Small OpenStreetMap buildings with no height tags, each researched (F, 2026-11-07): its tags and the map points inside it, else the GUGiK aerial and Mapillary street photos. x z = the outline's centre in map metres; u = what it is (game/scripts/small_buildings.gd draws it; part = a piece of a bigger building, none = nothing there: not drawn); h = height seen, m; conf = how sure; osm = the way id. tools/building_heights.py writes u and h into centrum.json.
